`gh pr view 2784 --json body` states the ~200-file limit and no 300-file claim

context: Found in the completion audit of the oracle replacement on 2026-10-09. The #2797 mismatch was found while preparing the external review; the owner authorized all three edits the same day. Independent of the code items; can run at any time.
description:
PR descriptions are the durable record readers search later. Three merged oracle PRs are wrong:
- #2797's description says the follow-up sweep defaults `DEFAULT_REVIEW_AUTHORS` to `benchbox-oracle[bot]` and `benchbox-oracle`. Its second commit (881873c51, "trust only the oracle Bot account as a default review author") changed that: develop has only `benchbox-oracle[bot]`, and _graphql_login adds `[bot]` only when GitHub reports a Bot account, so a human account named benchbox-oracle is not trusted. The same description says the four muse install steps check a pinned SHA-256; that stays true until oracle-muse-installer-floating-channel-20261009 merges, and needs no edit.
- #2784's test plan says "A 300-file marker fits with its patch map; a 1000-file one keeps only the digest." Measured on develop: the map is kept only up to about 200 files (210 with no open defects).
- #2758's title is "feat/oracle review cutover" (squash commit 96c26ad3c), which reads as a branch name. The commit title on develop cannot change; the PR title can.

Authorization (owner, 2026-10-09): edit these three merged PRs.

Required edits.
- #2797: replace the follow-up-sweep bullet with the Bot-only default and the reason.
- #2784: replace the 300-file sentence with the measured limit (about 200 files with 10 open defects; above it only the digest is kept and follow-ups become full reviews).
- #2758: retitle to a plain description of the change, for example "feat(oracle): make the oracle the required soundness reviewer".

Guardrails.
- Edit only the named sentence or title; leave every other part of each body byte for byte. Fetch the body with `gh pr view <n> --json body -q .body` into the scratchpad, edit that file, and apply with `gh pr edit <n> --body-file <file>`; diff before and after.
- No session or process wording in the new text (no "audit", "handoff", "follow-up item" ids); write for a reader who never saw the session.
- No attribution lines.

Decision gate. None remaining; the owner authorized the edits on 2026-10-09.
